idea-plugin.name: Copy Plus
idea-plugin.description:
在编辑器中选中代码后右键，使用 Copy with Location 即可把选中内容连同文件绝对路径和行号一起复制到剪贴板，方便粘贴到 AI 提示词中。
Select code in the editor, right-click and choose Copy with Location to copy the selection together with the absolute file path and line number — handy for AI prompts.

action.description: Copy selection with file path and line number
